statement.text: Conjecture (solved) If $a \times^{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\operatorname{RLD}}}} b \subseteq \left( \mathsf{\ensuremath{\operatorname{RLD}}} \right)_{\ensuremath{\operatorname{in}}} f$ then $a \times^{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\operatorname{FCD}}}} b \subseteq f$ for every funcoid $f$ and atomic f.o. $a$ and $b$ on the source and destination of $f$ correspondingly. A stronger conjecture: Conjecture If $\mathcal{A} \times^{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\operatorname{RLD}}}} \mathcal{B} \subseteq \left( \mathsf{\ensuremath{\operatorname{RLD}}} \right)_{\ensuremath{\operatorname{in}}} f$ then $\mathcal{A} \times^{\mathsf{\ensuremath{\operatorname{FCD}}}} \mathcal{B} \subseteq f$ for every funcoid $f$ and $\mathcal{A} \in \mathfrak{F} \left( \ensuremath{\operatorname{Src}}f \right)$, $\mathcal{B} \in \mathfrak{F} \left( \ensuremath{\operatorname{Dst}}f \right)$.
